headline: Homeowners' associations (HOAs) will be joined without an application. Bill approved in third reading
summary: Kyrgyzstan's Jogorku Kenesh approved in third reading amendments that let people join homeowner associations (TSZh) without a written application. The bill covers transparency in building management.
why: Changes to property management rules affect housing governance and service costs for residents in multi-unit buildings.
original_headline: В ТСЖ будут вступать без заявления. Законопроект одобрен в третьем чтении
